instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a side angle captures an indoor training studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands in profile, holding the woman's foot. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands with her back partially to the camera, extending her right leg in a high kick. The man (R1) catches and holds her right foot. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, creating a neutral color palette with soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R1 catches and holds R2's right foot during her high kick
R2 performs the high kick while R1 assists by holding her foot
R1 is the support/handler for R2's extended foot rather than the kicker
